gen-irish-grover-gf-ramabhadra: Irish Grover is chunky and friendly, with tall letters that look sturdy. Ramabhadra works beneath it as a plain sans with a prominent x-height, so make its size modest and let the heading do the shouting.
gen-irish-grover-gf-rambla: Soft, reed-pen curves give Irish Grover a hand-made, tall-standing look. Rambla follows in a plain sans whose small letters rise almost to capital height, so paragraphs feel compact, clear and steady.
gen-irish-grover-gf-recursive: Recursive reads like it was drawn with a ruler and compass, tidy and approachable, with a tall mean line. And Irish Grover supplies the opposite: sturdy, slightly swelling strokes that sit comfortably between flat and dramatic.
gen-irish-grover-gf-roboto-condensed: Irish Grover is playful and sturdy, its strokes lightly varied. Roboto Condensed is the plain sans beneath, tightly packed, with curves and straights sharing one width, like thread set against yarn.
gen-irish-grover-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Gentle stroke contrast, like a lightly flexed spring wire, gives Irish Grover its friendly spine. Saira Semi Condensed then runs a plain sans with no variation in thickness, so text looks slightly magnified and moves along smoothly.
gen-irish-grover-gf-secular-one: Irish Grover brings tall, organic lowercase with open a, c, e and s shapes and a readable, modest swing in weight. But Secular One is the sans-serif built for a dominant midsection and smooth, unmodulated lines, like a pen plotter.
gen-irish-grover-gf-smooch-sans: Sturdy, tall and playful. Irish Grover has stems just a touch thicker than its joins, while Smooch Sans packs a tight sans line with a high midline and a generous s, which makes the contrast the pair's best asset.
gen-irish-grover-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Irish Grover shapes tall, friendly words whose joins slim noticeably yet stay sturdy. And Sofia Sans Condensed handles the quieter work, with a big x-height, open unfinished loops and crossbars as fat as their stems.
gen-irish-grover-gf-spline-sans-mono: A faint swell in every curve, like pulled taffy, marks Irish Grover as soft and tall. Spline Sans Mono counters as a monospace with one stroke thickness everywhere, precise where the heading is playful.
gen-irish-grover-gf-strait: Strait is a sans with big round bowls and a friendly, modern air. Irish Grover sits over it with tall sturdy lowercase and arches that thin slightly off the stem, so the two feel like relatives with different volumes.
